verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a hosted remote MCP server (mcp.pipedream.net / mcp.pipedream.com) that developers can connect to directly via URL and headers with no infrastructure deployment, supporting SSE/streamable HTTP transports and built-in auth handling. Docs show explicit connection code with a remote URL and confirm no server setup is required by the developer. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and probes.
